=== THE GAP: THE REAL SESSION PANEL IS FIXTURE-DRIVEN, NOT REAL-DATA ===

Before you spend time on this: `src/views/useGateData.ts:75` hardcodes
`createFixtureSeam()`, and `src/data/index.ts:9` deliberately does not export
`createRealSeam` yet (this is a known, already-reported gap — the "SEAM NOTE" in my
original brief, contested Frontend-lane territory, not something I fixed or was asked
to). That means the app at :4612/ (the real shell, session panel, everything) is
currently rendering FIXTURE work_sessions with fixture ids — turning the dev flag on
there mounts a real `<LiveTerminal>`, but it'll try to attach to a FIXTURE session id
that has no backing row in `work_sessions` at all. The transport will connect, the
server will answer `1011 "no live PTY for session"` (honest — there genuinely is no
PTY for a fake id), and the panel will look "broken" in a way that has nothing to do
with the terminal transplant. If you see exactly that failure mode through the real
shell, that's the seam gap, not a P2 regression — don't burn time chasing it as one.

TWO WAYS TO SEE IT against REAL data right now, given that gap is still open:

 (a) My throwaway harness — `http://127.0.0.1:4612/terminal-dev.html?sessionId=<real id>`
     (packages/tm8-ui/terminal-dev.html + src/terminal-dev.tsx, both uncommitted/
     never-landing). Bypasses the fixture seam entirely, mounts real TerminalHost chrome
     + real LiveTerminal against a real sessionId you pass in the query string. This is
     what I used for all the observations in my last status report. Not the "real session
     panel" your coordinator wants seen, but it IS the real component tree minus the
     shell/routing/data layer around it.

 (b) Manually pointing the real shell at a real id would require either flipping
     `useGateData.ts`'s seam (Frontend lane's open file — I was told to report, not
     fight for it) or hand-patching a fixture entry's id to match a real spawned
     session's uuid before the app boots, which I have not tried and can't vouch for.

If milestone verification specifically needs the FULL real session panel (shell + real
seam + real session, not the harness), that's the same gap this whole track has been
routing through the coordinator rather than editing directly — worth raising with them
before you spend time trying to force it open yourself.

=== THE PROJECT-LINKAGE GOTCHA, IN CASE YOUR SPAWN CALL DOESN'T ALREADY KNOW IT ===

`projectId` on `execution.spawn` must be a `public.projects` row reachable via
`public.space_projects`, NOT an `entities` row of kind `project`. The entity id
404s with "not linked to this space" even though it's in the same space. Resolve it via:
  select p.id from public.projects p
    join public.space_projects sp on sp.project_id = p.id
   where sp.space_id = '<spaceId>';
Full writeup in my memory file if you want the mechanism, not just the fact.
